Account-level Automation
Pioneering company-level automation since 2017
Are your customers B2B teams? You shouldn’t be emailing a flat list. Userlist matches your data architecture, relationships, and roles.
View API documentation
Separate segmentation for companies
Userlist offers two sets of segments: users and companies. Understand your accounts and how they move through their lifecycle.
Account-level workflows
Trigger workflows based on what happens on the company level, and then decide what team members receive the message (based on their role or use case).
Many-to-many relationships
Our data model reflects the complexity of your SaaS business. Userlist supports properties for users, companies, and relationships.
Examples
Really, really, really advanced
Let’s geek out. See examples of powerful things you can do in Userlist with customer data, segments, and workflows.
Example 1. Filter users based on complex activity
Let’s find users on Professional plan
Who performed event album_created at least 10 times during the last 30 days
Only counting gallery type albums with over 100 photos ( see API docs for event properties)
Example 2. Segment users based on company criteria
Let’s create a segment of users who belong to at least 2 companies
While these companies should be paying customers on the Professional plan
And have more than 20 albums in their account
Example 3. Create advanced workflow triggers
Let’s trigger a workflow when a company approaches their renewal in 2 weeks
But they have been dormant and haven’t created any albums during the last 11 months
And only send this workflow to admins of such accounts
Example 4. Combine manual and self-serve onboarding
Let’s identify high-volume trials in your onboarding flow
Then send an internal note to your CS team to start manual onboarding
Create a custom event in user timeline, indicating that manual onboarding was started
Meanwhile, low-volume users receive a regular email for self-serve onboarding

As you grow your user base, we’ll make sure everything runs smooth, and you keep getting good ROI for every user in the database.

Frequently Asked Questions
How do you calculate my monthly cost?
We automatically calculate the monthly fee based on your number of users. We look at your previous 30 days and use the “high-water mark” number of users in your account.
Do you count all users, or just active users?
We count all users in your Userlist account, because we store and continuously analyze their behavior data, even if there’s no recent activity.
Do you support high-volume pricing?
Yes, we do. Both Basic and Professional plans have dynamic pricing rates that go down as your list grows. That’s enabled automatically. Use the slider above to see how that works for your list size.
Do I need to have all users in Userlist?
The idea is to have all your customers here, so that you can contact them when necessary (think of a privacy policy update). However, sometimes it makes sense to use Userlist with a certain type of users only.
Can I remove users?
You can always remove users via the API if you have high turnover rate, many abandoned accounts, or just want to optimize your costs.
Can I use Userlist for my marketing email list?
Yes, Userlist is great for handling both marketing leads and customers within the same tool. You can use our Forms feature to build your email list with lead magnets.
Do you support early-stage startups?
Yes, we support SaaS companies who have raised less than $500k total in funding (new accounts only). If you qualify, please start your free trial and let us know. We’ll apply a 50% discount to your account for the first 12 months.
Can I try Userlist for free?
Absolutely, we offer a free 14-day trial for all plans. We’ll ask for your card details upfront — this helps us prevent spam and provide a better onboarding experience for you.
Have other questions?
Get in touch anytime at support@userlist.com . We’re always there to help.
